Healthcare revenue

Billing for US practices.

Give your practice a billing partner who can work within your clearinghouse and meet during US-friendly hours.

Discuss this service View brief
Scope of work

What we work on.

Agree on the handoff

Together we map practice systems, payer mix, claim volume and responsibilities. Billing operations are delivered with SuperBillOne LLC.

Keep claims moving

Options include eligibility and authorisation checks, claim scrubbing, clearinghouse submission, payer follow-up and denial appeals.

Review exceptions together

A named account contact escalates urgent items and schedules reporting calls around the practice. Clinical questions and approval decisions go back to your team.

Deliverables

What you receive.

  • Discovery around specialty, payers, systems and working hours.
  • An agreed workflow and a limited batch of claims for the pilot.
  • Monthly review call and written action list for the practice.
Delivery partner

US healthcare operations.

Cloud Haven coordinates billing work with SuperBillOne LLC, a US-registered medical billing company in Austin, Texas. Your introductory call covers the practice workflow, payer mix and the responsibilities on each side.

Meet the billing partner
Questions

Before you start.

Will we need to change billing systems?

Where compatible, the billing team works through access your practice grants in its existing system. The fit is discussed at discovery.

When are review calls scheduled?

Coverage and calls are agreed around the practice’s hours. The team documents the schedule before launch.

What should we review before sharing patient data?

Discuss access controls, current security documentation and business associate agreement arrangements directly with the team during scoping.
